integrity: The theorem has a written algebraic proof; exact finite-field verification is corroborative, not a replacement for an infinite-field argument. No independent scientific validation was carried out.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-two fields only; reduced tangential image and geometric generic incidence only. No classification of singularities, nongeneric fibers, or arithmetic descent. Historical priority is provisional pending more specialist literature.
title: A characteristic-two (2,3) tangential complete intersection for the degree-six del Pezzo surface
